name: publish-provider
description: Assembles the on-chain dDRM content mint (unsigned); binds contentId == bytes16 KID and derives the tokenURI, holding no chain-RPC or wallet key
author: elastos

authority.reason: Assembles the content-mint transaction (contentId, tokenURI, opType) for chain-provider to broadcast and wallet-provider to sign. Holds no chain RPC, no wallet keys, and cannot broadcast — capability-clean by construction.
